ValidationRule.description: Require users to select a Won Reason at Verbal Commit or Closed Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Existing Business")), ISCHANGED( StageName ), OR ( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Verbal Commit" ), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Closed Won") ), ISBLANK(Won_Reason__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a reason this Opportunity was Won before changing to Verbal Commit or Closed Won
